user_reported_differences: Settings select becomes blank after choosing an option.
Settings checkbox cannot be rechecked after unchecking.
Selected tags in create/edit task form do not change color.
diagnosis: The inline SettingsPanel uses fire('update', key, value) directly in San event expressions, but San custom events carry one payload object; the parent handler does not unpack a key/value payload. The task form class depends on an inline array method expression that did not refresh the selected style after its tag data changed.
repair: Use explicit SettingsPanel event handlers that fire one {key, value} payload, unpack $event in the parent binding, and maintain a reactive selectedTagMap alongside formData.tags for tag classes. Keep the previous candidate and all frozen evidence unchanged.

verification.direct_san_child_checks: settings emitted {key,value} for select and false/true checkbox changes; tag selection map updated on click and reset when switching to new task
